mechanism_narrative: A higher current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated interest rates compress equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 900 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which typically precedes a recession and triggers a flight to quality in equities, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 900.0, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0% and housing starts (HOUST) falls below 900 thousand units, the combination signals a deepening economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0 AND HOUST < 900.0, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL annual growth > 2.0%), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy adjusts to higher interest rates and inflation, reducing equity valuations.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5 AND CPIAUCSL annual growth > 2.0%, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated unemployment signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings growth potential.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0%, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 index units signals a weakening economy, prompting central banks to ease monetary policy, which results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 110.0, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110 and housing starts (HOUST) falls below 900 thousand units, the combined weakness in manufacturing and housing signals an imminent recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 110.0 AND HOUST < 900.0, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to a flight to quality and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates central bank intervention.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.5, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
